sentences.text:
Date : 15.11. 2023 Page No.# 2/2 Heard Ms. J. Barman, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms.
SH Bora, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C., filed by the petitioner seeking bail in connection with Tamarhat P.S. Case No. 128/2023 (Corresponding to GR Case No. 1585/2023) under Section 376 IPC read with Sections 9/10/11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act read with Sections 6/17 of POCSO Act.

Call for the case diary along with the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
Issue notice to the respondent No. 2.
The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent No. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as usual process, returnable on 30.11.2023.
No formal notice need be served upon the respondent No. 1 as Ms. SH Bora, learned Addl. PP has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the said respondent.
